originalTitle: Taxpayers to fund clear-up of illegal dumps in West Yorkshire, Surrey and Kent
summary: Andy Burnham promises drive to tackle toxic waste, raise fines and use AI-powered drones to detect illegal activity
content: Illegal dumps in West Yorkshire, Surrey and Kent will be cleared up using taxpayer money, Andy Burnham has announced, as the prime minister promises a new drive to tackle toxic waste. Ministers have identified dumps in Bradford, Runnymede and the Isle of Sheppey, which collectively contain about 22,000 tonnes of illegal waste, to be cleared in the next phase of the government’s national clear-up effort. Meanwhile, fines will be raised for rogue dumpers, and AI-powered drones will be used to detect illegal activity while it happens, as the government looks to prioritise prevention alongside clean-up efforts. Burnham said in a statement: “These toxic dumps have blighted communities for too long. I said we would clean them up – and that’s exactly what we’re announcing today.” He added: “These mountains of rubbish have been a clear sign to communities that politics hasn’t been working for them or their area. This government is going to tackle the issues that have been ignored by Westminster for too long and bring back hope.” Hundreds of illegal waste sites have been reported across England, with a BBC investigation recently uncovering 11 “supersites” that contain more than 20,000 tonnes of rubbish. One of the country’s most notorious sites is in Burnham’s own constituency of Makerfield, where a rotting, rat-infested mountain of waste has remained for more than 20 months. The site was identified for clean-up in March alongside two others, but locals say they have seen little improvement in the site since then. During the byelection campaign, which Burnham won earlier this year, voters in the area told the Guardian they would vote for him specifically to get rid of that one site. The Environment Agency says it has made 42 site visits, suspended or revoked 17 permits and launched more than 30 criminal investigations as part of its initial crackdown. In February, Varun Datta, the ringleader of a waste crime gang, was ordered to pay £1.4m after being convicted for the organised illegal dumping of mostly municipal waste at a network of 16 sites across the country, including at a historic manor house and a nature reserve in Lancashire. Downing Street said the three new sites identified on Wednesday had been chosen because of their scale, the risk to nearby communities, their environmental damage, and links to organised crime. Officials said the new push to prevent illegal dumping would work better than previous approaches, in part because of new AI-powered drones which are designed to detect dumping while it happens. The 33 drones will be fitted with light detection and ranging technology, which can create highly detailed maps of illegal waste sites. Burnham also said he wanted police and the National Crime Agency to be given a bigger role, as he announced fines for people who dump waste illegally or fail to treat it correctly would rise from £300 to £5,000. Tougher sanctions, including imprisonment, are already available for more serious offences. Meanwhile, in West Yorkshire and Greater Manchester mayors and council leaders will be asked to coordinate councils, police, regulators and other enforcement agencies to ramp up crime prevention efforts.
chineseTitle: 纳税人资助清理西约克郡、萨里和肯特郡的非法垃圾场
chineseSummary: 安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 承诺推动解决有毒废物、提高罚款并使用人工智能无人机来检测非法活动
chineseContent: 安迪·伯纳姆宣布，西约克郡、萨里和肯特郡的非法垃圾场将用纳税人的钱清理，总理承诺采取新的行动来解决有毒废物问题。部长们已经确定了布拉德福德、兰尼米德和谢佩岛的垃圾场，这些垃圾场总共含有约 22,000 吨非法废物，将在政府下一阶段的全国清理工作中进行清理。与此同时，政府将提高对流氓倾倒者的罚款，并且人工智能驱动的无人机将被用来检测发生的非法活动，因为政府希望将预防与清理工作放在一起。伯纳姆在一份声明中说：“这些有毒垃圾场长期以来一直困扰着社区。我说过我们会清理它们——这正是我们今天宣布的。”他补充道：“这些堆积如山的垃圾向社区发出了一个明确的信号，即政治对他们或他们的地区不起作用。本届政府将解决威斯敏斯特长期以来忽视的问题，并带回希望。”据报道，英格兰各地存在数百个非法垃圾场，BBC 的一项调查最近发现了 11 个“超级垃圾场”，其中垃圾量超过 20,000 吨。该国最臭名昭著的地点之一位于伯纳姆自己的马克菲尔德选区，那里堆积如山的腐烂、老鼠出没的垃圾已经存在了 20 多个月。该地点于三月份与另外两个地点一起被确定进行清理，但当地人表示，自那以后，他们发现该地点几乎没有任何改善。在伯纳姆今年早些时候赢得的补选中，该地区的选民告诉《卫报》，他们将专门投票给他，以摆脱那个网站。环境局表示已进行 42 次现场视察，暂停或吊销 17 份许可证，并启动了
